# Refinzi 2.0

> Refinzi is an ambient Windows desktop AI companion that rebuilds raw, vague thoughts into production-grade prompts in 2 seconds directly in-place across any Windows application.

## Overview
Refinzi eliminates repetitive prompt engineering and trial-and-error AI re-prompting. Users simply highlight text anywhere on Windows and press the global hotkey `Ctrl+Alt+Space` to instantly refine their prompt for leading AI models.

## Key Capabilities
- **Universal Windows In-Place Rebuilding**: Works inside ChatGPT web, Claude, Cursor IDE, VS Code, Discord, Notion, Figma, Midjourney Discord, or web browsers without copy-pasting.
- **Model-Specific Intelligence Engines**:
  - **ChatGPT & Gemini**: Multi-step chain-of-thought reasoning, persona grounding, and structured system instructions.
  - **Midjourney & AI Image Generators**: Optical focal lengths, anamorphic lenses, lighting vectors, and rendering flags (`--ar 16:9`, `--style raw`).
  - **Higgsfield AI & Video Engines**: Cinematic 3D orbital camera physics, volumetric lighting, and temporal velocity curves.
  - **Cursor & Claude**: 5-Block architectural blueprints (scaffolding, component token matrix, conversion copy, motion dynamics, model rules).
- **Zero-Latency Execution**: Native lightweight Windows app (< 40 MB RAM, runs on Windows 10 & 11).
- **Privacy First (Local-First)**: Clipboard selections and user API keys are handled locally and never stored on third-party servers.

## Pricing & Availability
- **Free BYOK (Bring Your Own Key)**: Unlimited usage with free tier or user API keys. Zero monthly subscriptions.
- **Lifetime Pro ($29 one-time)**: Managed high-speed AI routing (Claude 3.5 Sonnet / GPT-4o), unlimited 5-Block Blueprint synthesis, cloud preset sync, and lifetime updates.
- **Website & Download**: https://refinzi.com
- **Official Windows Installer**: https://github.com/papada1472/Promptsmith/releases/download/v2.0.0/Refinzi-Setup-v2.0.0.exe
